content:
Meta has launched a brand-new iPhone app officially called Seller, a Facebook app. The new Meta app is specifically for Facebook users managing listings on Marketplace, the social network’s virtual storefront for physical items.

The new Seller app is only designed for iPhone, though it will run on iPad and Mac as well.

Here’s the new app’s official description:

Seller is a dedicated selling app for Facebook Marketplace. Manage your listings, message your buyers, and track your performance — all in one place.

See what needs your attention. Your seller home dashboard surfaces what matters first — items to ship, buyers to respond to, listings to reprice — alongside a snapshot of how your sales are performing.

Create listings fast. Upload photos and Meta AI fills in the details — title, description, price, category — so you can publish fast.

Manage your inventory at scale. Reprice, relist, or delete in bulk. Create multiple listings at once.

Your buyer messages, all in one place. Buyer conversations live here, separate from personal chats. See who’s serious, respond faster, and never miss a message.

Track what’s working. See which listings are getting views, saves, and messages. Get pricing recommendations and relisting suggestions based on what’s actually selling.

And here are screenshots from the new listing:

Seller is the second new iPhone app introduced by Meta this week. The company also released an AI-powered children’s story creation app called StoryKit, although it’s a limited test in select markets.

The new Seller app for Facebook Marketplace is available broadly for free on the App Store. Meta shared an announcement post about the new app today as well.
